Sinara Pool Villas

Villa in Thalang
HomeSaleSinara Pool Villas

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A six-villa low-density pool villa development of about 3,500 sqm in Khao Phra Thaeo, with large plots, floor-to-ceiling glazing and a greenery and stream setting. Villas come as 3BR or 4BR, each with a private pool and two parking spaces.

Sinara Pool Villas: key facts

  • Sinara Pool Villas is a pool villa in Thalang, Phuket.
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 478.8–479.6 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿17,500,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: UWC Thailand Phuket (0.9 km); Thalang Hospital Phuket (2.6 km); Bumrungrad Hospital Phuket (7.5 km); HEI Schools Phuket (7.8 km).
